_readme: Korean casting for tools/voice_tts.js --lang ko (owner 2026-10-10). Lines: design/voice/ko_lines.csv (tools/voice_en_lines.js --lang ko; text of v2/src/i18n/ko). Audio: assets/voice/ko/<id>.ogg.

voice: a native Korean (ko-KR, Seoul) prebuilt persona voice from GET /v1beta/voices (117 listed), chosen by its listed gender, age, pitch and tone (note = what the listing says) to match the character in the English casting (casting_en.json): same gender and age class, similar tone. Every speaker has an own voice; melda and mistwitch share one on purpose (the fog imitates the witch's voice).

Only the voice changes: profile, style, per-line direction, fx and pitch come from design/voice/casting.json (profile / style here replace the Japanese-mode text where it talks about Japanese speech). Pure cries (design/voice/cry_reuse.txt) are not voiced: the game plays the Japanese file.
